The Diet of Hungary or originally: Parlamentum Publicum / Parlamentum Generale [ 1 ] ( Hungarian : Országgyűlés ) was the most important political assembly in Hungary since the 12th century, which emerged to the position of the supreme legislative institution in the Kingdom of Hungary from the 1290s, [ 2 ] and in its successor states, Royal Hungary and the Habsburg kingdom of Hungary throughout the early modern period until the end of World War II.
